title: A Spring Day at the Zoo
setting: A zoo by a river, with a small farm corner.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: Ivan, a young boy with short black hair and blue overalls

sentences.en: It is a cloudy, rainy morning in spring.
sentences.zh: 这是一个多云下雨的春天早晨。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Ivan, a young boy with short black hair and blue overalls in raincoats walk into a zoo under grey clouds and light rain, spring blossoms on the trees.

sentences.en: A baby elephant plays in the river.
sentences.scene_prompt: A baby elephant splashes happily in a shallow river.

sentences.en: This winter baby is now the zoo's star.
sentences.zh: 这头冬天出生的小象现在是动物园的明星。
sentences.scene_prompt: Many visitors, with Sara, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Ivan, a young boy with short black hair and blue overalls, crowd around the baby elephant and cheer.

sentences.en: A tiger sleeps among the red flowers.
sentences.zh: 一只老虎睡在红色的花丛中。
sentences.scene_prompt: A tiger sleeps peacefully among red flowers.

sentences.en: Ivan lets a little pig eat from his hand.
sentences.zh: 伊万让一只小猪从他手里吃东西。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a young boy with short black hair and blue overalls holds out his hand and a little pink pig eats from it.

sentences.en: Sara sits on a brown horse for ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 萨拉在一匹棕色的马上坐了十分钟。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt sits on a calm brown horse in a small paddock.

sentences.en: Then the sun comes out in the sky.
sentences.zh: 然后太阳在天空中出来了。
sentences.scene_prompt: The sun breaks through the clouds in a bright sky over the zoo.

sentences.en: Sara and Ivan love every animal here.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和伊万喜爱这里的每一只动物。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Ivan, a young boy with short black hair and blue overalls smile happily in front of the elephant, tiger, pig and horse.
